title: Do you take responsibility for your actions?
html:
Hi there,

Do you take responsibility for your actions?

Have you ever thought about the difference it would make to your life if you did? Like, really thought about it .... [now's the time]

When you don’t accept responsibility it can slow your forward progress down because you can become;

  • Fearful about taking risks or making decisions

  • Unsuccessful at the projects you take on

  • Unsuccessful in personal relationships 🙁

  • Emotionally or physically unhealthy

When you accept responsibility for your actions you will find new opportunities will present themselves.

When you accept responsibility for your actions you will find life is less stressful 🙂

Accepting personal responsibility includes:

  • Acknowledging that you are solely responsible for the choices in your life.

  • Accepting that you are responsible for what you choose to feel or think.

  • Accepting that you choose the direction for your life.

  • Accepting that you cannot blame others for the choices you have made.

  • The rational belief that you are responsible for determining who you are, and how your choices affect your life.

  • Recognising that you are your best cheerleader.

  • Taking preventive health-oriented steps of structuring your life with time management, stress management, confronting fears, and burnout prevention.

  • Taking an honest inventory of your strengths, abilities, talents, virtues, and positive points - this is vital. Do it!

So, this week have a successful week and take responsibility for your actions.

Kind regards,

Glenn “Take no prisoners” Edley
